name: EzServerInfo
tagline: Privately shows a server's type, version, IP, location, plugins, MOTD, ping and player count in your chat when you first join, or with /serverinfo.
description: EzServerInfo prints a **framed summary of the server you just joined** in your own chat. It appears automatically the **first time you join each server**, and any time you run **`/serverinfo`**. It is client-side and private: nothing is sent to other players, and nothing is needed on the server.

list: **Server Type**: Paper, Spigot, Purpur, Folia, Velocity, BungeeCord, Fabric and more
**Server Version**: the version the server reports, plus the range of client versions it accepts when ViaVersion-style multi-version support is detected
**Server IP**: the domain you typed and the IPv4 address behind it
**Server Location**: a rough location for that IP
**Server Plugins**: read from `/plugins` or `/pl` when your permissions allow it
**Server MOTD**: shown with the server's own colours

description: Every line starts with an aqua `┃` bar inside a framed block, so it can't be mistaken for server chat that arrives at the same time. The block uses just three colours: aqua for the frame and labels, green for values, and gray for secondary text.

list: **Plugins are listed silently.** The mod only sends `/plugins` (or `/pl`) if the server offers that command to you, and it hides the reply from your chat.

**Location lookup uses an online service.** The server's IP is sent to ipwho.is (or ip-api.com as a fallback) to find a rough location. For servers behind a proxy such as Cloudflare it shows the proxy's location. You can turn this off.
**Supported-version detection** sends a few dozen short status pings to the server. Some hosts rate-limit these, in which case the result is marked "approximate".
Singleplayer and LAN worlds are ignored.

Settings live in `config/ezserverinfo.json`: `showOnFirstJoin`, `queryPlugins`, `locationLookup` and `probeSupportedVersions`. Servers already announced are remembered in `config/ezserverinfo-seen.json`; delete an entry to see it again.
Needs **Fabric API**. Java 21 for 1.21.11, Java 25 for 26.1 and newer.

changelog: Framed, easy-to-spot chat block with just three colours
Shows server type, version, IP, location, plugins, MOTD, ping and player count on first join or with /serverinfo
